episode_summary: Megan Walters shares her journey to becoming a top 1% REALTOR without buying leads or cold calling. She emphasizes the importance of personal branding, social media marketing, and using public spaces to generate leads. Megan also discusses her real estate investment strategies and how she manages productivity by starting her day early.
